about.en: Aim to become a Tasteful Software Engineer
about.zh: 目标成为有品味的软件工程师

career.en: Served as a delivery engineer at Alibaba, participating in the construction of internal efficiency platforms, providing front-end solutions for delivery projects externally, and writing code to achieve service fulfillment.
career.zh: 在阿里巴巴任职期间担任交付工程师，对内参与内部效能平台建设，对外提供交付项目前端解决方案，编写代码实现服务履约。

schoolwork.en: During university, often served as the project team leader, responsible for and participated in the design and front-end development of multiple applications, gaining experience in coordination, planning, and collaborative communication. Passed CET-4 and CET-6. Received school-level scholarships in all academic years.
schoolwork.zh: 在大学期间常担任项目组长的角色，负责及参与过多个应用的设计和前端开发，得到统筹安排、合作沟通方面能力的锻炼。通过 CET-4 和 CET-6。在所有学年均获得校级奖学金。

company.en: Alibaba Cloud Southwest Information Technology Co., Ltd.
company.zh: 阿里云西南信息科技有限公司

description.en: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence - System Engineering Technology Department. Undertook requirement development for the Yunqiao platform internally, and participated in the delivery of projects such as China Nuclear Power Unified R&D Platform and Guiyang Airport Qianyunyigou
description.zh: 阿里云智能 - 系统工程技术部。对内承接云巧平台的需求研发，对外参与过中国核电统一研发平台、贵阳机场黔云易购等项目的交付履约

company.zh: 阿里巴巴（成都）软件技术有限公司

description.en: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence - Global Technical Services Department. Undertook requirement development for the Eco Partner Workbench of the Global Technical Services Department
description.zh: 阿里云智能 - 全球技术服务部。承接全球技术服务部生态伙伴工作台的需求研发

company.zh: 华为技术有限公司成都研究所

description.en: Storage Business Infrastructure - Container Platform Group. Refactored and developed CDBI, set up and deployed independent verification environments, wrote deployment scripts, and authored over ten technical documents and blog posts. Awarded as Outstanding Star of Huawei Storage (top 20%)
description.zh: 存储业务基础设施项目群 - 容器平台组。重构开发 CDBI，搭建部署独立验证环境，编写部署脚本，撰写十余篇文档博客。获评优秀华储星（前 20%）

school.en: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

shortIntro.zh: 云巧产业数字组件中心

description.en: As the front-end lead, participated in the development and maintenance of Yunqiao Workshop and Yunqiao Asset Market, and contributed to the baseline development and customized development of the commercial version. Improved the user experience and optimized the performance of the Domain-Driven Design diagram editor in Yunqiao Workshop
description.zh: 作为前端负责人参与云巧工坊和云巧资产市场的开发与维护，参与商业化版本的基线开发与定制开发。对云巧工坊的领域驱动设计（Domain-Driven Design）图编辑器进行体验改进及性能优化

description.en: Guiyang Airport delivery project, a collaborative promotional activity platform for automotive and liquor companies. As the front-end lead, completed the development, integration, and launch of the mini-program, and participated in regular iterations and maintenance
description.zh: 贵阳机场交付项目，车企酒企联动促销活动实施平台，作为前端负责人完成小程序开发、联调与上线，参与小程序的常规迭代与维护

description.en: Undertook the Mini Program 2.0 version UI upgrade requirements, fully responsible for restoring the front-end design drafts and integration work, fixing known issues, and optimizing user experience
description.zh: 承接小程序 2.0 版本 UI 升级需求，全权负责前端设计稿还原与联调工作，修复已知问题并优化用户体验

shortIntro.zh: 星轨轻量级任务调度工具

description.en: A lightweight task scheduling tool based on AntV X6 that arranges server-side task execution logic via drag-and-drop. Supports multiple execution modes including serial and parallel, supports editing different task nodes such as Shell and Python, and supports validity checking and automatic node arrangement
description.zh: 基于 AntV X6 实现的轻量级任务调度工具，以拖拽的方式编排服务端任务执行逻辑。支持添加串行、并行等多种运行逻辑，支持编辑 Shell、Python 等不同任务节点，支持合法性校验和自动排列

description.en: Participated in the official website upgrade project in collaboration between DAMO Academy and Yunqiao, responsible for the transformation and development of the login/registration module and personal account management module
description.zh: 参与达摩院与云巧合作的官网升级项目，负责登录注册模块和个人账户管理模块的改造与开发

shortIntro.en: Online Repair System for Dormitory Network of UESTC
shortIntro.zh: 电子科技大学宿舍网络在线报修系统

description.en: Campus network users can submit repair orders online and track order progress. Network management committee maintainers can accept orders, add processing information, and view order operation logs
description.zh: 校园网用户可以在线提交报修订单并追踪订单进行状况，网络管理委员会的维修人员能够接取订单，添加处理信息以及查看订单操作日志等

shortIntro.zh: 电子科技大学 LUG 主页

description.en: Use Markdown to write news and blogs, provide navigation links to various services, and better showcase the LUG team. Design inspired by Tsinghua University TUNA Association's official website
description.zh: 使用 Markdown 编写新闻和博客，提供各种服务的导航链接，更好地展现 LUG 团队的风采。设计参考清华大学 TUNA 协会官网

description.en: A client designed for families of lost elderly and volunteers searching for them. Families can view rescue progress and mark frequently visited locations; volunteers can view team member positions, set search areas, and add notes. Uses Lark for information synchronization and intelligence aggregation
description.zh: 面向走失老人的家属和寻找走失老人的志愿者设计的客户端。家属能够查看搜救进展，标注老人常去地点等；志愿者可以查看队员位置，设置搜索区域和添加备注等；使用飞书进行信息同步和情报汇总

description.en: A timetable-driven WeChat Mini Program for collaborative to-do management among college students. After joining a class, students share timetables, course to-do items, and class public affairs with classmates
description.zh: 由课程表驱动的大学生协作待办事务微信小程序。加入班级后，与同班同学共享课程表、课程待办事务和班级公共事务

shortIntro.zh: 一款现代的 Hexo 博客主题

description.en: As a collaborator, developed new features including dark mode, improved mobile page adaptation, fixed community issues, and helped the theme become better. The repository currently has over 1.6k stars on GitHub
description.zh: 作为协作者，开发包括夜间模式在内的新功能，完善移动端页面适配，修复已知的问题，帮助主题变得更好。主题仓库目前在 Github 上拥有超过 1.6k 星标

shortIntro.zh: 将 Markdown 转换为图片

description.en: Allows custom templates to convert input Markdown or HTML documents into images that suit your preferences
description.zh: 允许自定义模板，将输入的 Markdown 或 HTML 文档转换为符合心意的图片

description.en: An Electron application based on EfficientIR that supports finding duplicate image pairs and searching for similar results of a specified image
description.zh: 基于 EfficientIR 封装的 Electron 应用，支持查找重复图像对，搜索指定图像的相似结果

shortIntro.zh: 对 Gitalk 组件的现代化实现

description.en: Reimplemented the Gitalk component based on React, TypeScript, and Vite, providing a better development experience and adding more features, including automatic folding of long comments
description.zh: 基于 React，TypeScript 和 Vite 重新实现 Gitalk 组件，提供更好的开发体验，同时新增包括自动折叠长评论在内的更多功能

shortIntro.zh: 献给人类的设计模式教程

description.en: The Chinese translation of the open-source repository design-patterns-for-humans, for reference when learning design patterns
description.zh: 开源仓库 design-patterns-for-humans 的中文翻译版本，供学习设计模式时参考

description.en: Responsible for the front-end design of the 'About Us' and 'Sub-venue' pages
description.zh: 负责「关于我们」和「分会场」页面前端设计

name.zh: 阿里云云计算工程师 ACP 认证

name.zh: 2021 年中国大学生服务外包创新创业大赛
